title: Cure the Poisoned Gnome
html:
Cure the Poisoned Gnome is a Quest in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. The quest can be obtained by speaking with  Thulla at the Myconid Colony at Ebonlake Grotto.

Objectives

Objectives and journal entries may vary pending story decisions and outcomes.

Find a cure for Thulla.
  • "We met Thulla, a deep gnome who was poisoned. The Underdark might hold a cure, but we have to be quick, she won't survive for long."
  • "Some time has passed, and Thulla's condition may have worsened. We need to find the cure before it's too late."
  • "Thulla is on death's door. The poison will kill her soon - we can't afford to rest."
Cure Thulla.
  • "We found an antidote. Maybe this will help Thulla.
  • "We found an extremely rare noblestalk mushroom, famous for its healing properties. It could help Thulla, or it could help us get rich."
Check in on Thulla.
  • "Thulla underwent an unusual transformation - we should check in on her."
Quest Complete
  • "We cured Thulla - she was very thankful."
  • "Thulla died before being cured."
  • "We're too late. Thulla died, and the myconids transformed her."
  • "We left Thulla behind."

Walkthrough

 Thulla is a deep gnome slave taking refuge in the Myconid Colony. She is at X: 83 Y: -97, on the same mushroom platform as  Sovereign Spaw.

When the party first encounters Thulla, a successful passive Nature check reveals that she has been poisoned by a wild weed from the Underdark. She is afflicted with  Duergar Poison and has had her health reduced. The interacting party member can make a Medicine check to determine that she can indeed be cured via antidotes or natural remedies:

[1]
  • [DUERGAR] Consider what you know of your people's poison lore. (auto-success)
  • [MEDICINE] Consider what you know of duergar poison lore. (DC 15 ) (If Nature check passed)
  • [MEDICINE] Consider what you know of duergar poison lore. (DC 15) (If Nature check not passed)

Once spoken with, Thulla must be cured within three Long Rests. After the third Long Rest, she dies and becomes a myconid husk.

Thulla can be cured by items that remove the  Poisoned condition:

[1]
  • Give her the antidote.
  • Give her the Elixir of Silvanus.
  • Give her an antitoxin.
  • Give her a Remedial Potion.
  • Give her an Elixir of Poison Resistance.
  • Give her the noblestalk as a cure.

One of the possible items to cure Thulla is a  Duergar Antidote in the possession  Gekh Coal, who is in the Decrepit Village or by following the ⁠Defeat the Duergar Intruders quest. Ceratin spells and abilities such as  Lesser Restoration also cure Thulla.

After saving Thulla, she offers the  Boots of Speed she stole from  Sergeant Thrinn as a reward. She asks the party to go and save the rest of her clan of Ironhand Gnomes who are being held captive in Grymforge, thus opening up the quest ⁠Save the Grymforge Gnomes.

Picking any of the following options result in Thulla dying and failing the quest:

[1]
  • She won't last long. Finish her off.
  • [PERSUASION] You're in a bad way. I could end your suffering, if you want. (DC 15)
    • Give her a quick death.

Waiting 3 long rests also results in her death and a failing the quest.

Quest rewards

  • Boots of Speed
